prev.note: The crop shows empty stone instead of a previous button, meaning the control is missing entirely in the layout.

repeat.note: Dial-like knob with an arrow, visually fits the aesthetic.

vol.note: The crop is completely blank/empty stone. It seems the volume knob was either not rendered or placed incorrectly outside the crop zone.

seek.note: The original idle state has a painted-in thumb labeled 'ON'. The active state shows a CSS fill that misaligns with the track and overlaps the baked-in painted thumb. Also has visible text ('ON').

shuffle.note: The original idle state has a painted-in lever arm. The active state adds a second overlapping lever sprite without removing the underlying painted one. Contains visible text ('ON').

visualizer.note: Screen area is clean, CSS bars visible at bottom.

album_art.note: Clean screen frame for album art.

notes: Several controls are completely missing from their designated crop zones (prev, vol), resulting in phantom-control / dead-control tags.
The layout contains an unexplained decorative gear window in the top left, which is not a requested control but takes up significant space.
The seek slider and shuffle toggle both suffer from baked-in thumbs and overlapping active sprites.
Text ('ON') is baked into the UI near the slider and toggle.
Aesthetic is nice, hitting the Myst/Arcanum stone and brass brief well, but the layout and functionality are broken.
improve: Ensure all requested controls (prev, vol) are generated in the UI layout.
Do not paint the moving parts (slider thumbs, toggle levers) into the background image; leave the tracks empty so dynamic sprites can move freely.
Remove all baked-in text like 'ON' from the design.
Ensure CSS tracks for sliders perfectly match the bounds of the painted grooves.
